scientific_integrity: The infinite-domain result has an analytic finite-rank proof; numerical checker provides independent finite checks, not a substitute for the proof. No independent expert validation.
scientific_limitations: Linear undamped infinite Euler–Bernoulli beam, two equal concentrated negative point stiffnesses, no axial force; continuous-domain proof only within \(\sqrt2<a<2\sqrt2\). Nonlinear and engineering robustness not established. Relevant inaccessible complete 2005 and 2010 primary articles leave historical priority risk.
title: Infinitely many reentrant instability windows for two point softeners on a Winkler beam
